items.title: Trump casts doubt on US midterm results with new fraud claims
items.description:
United States President Donald Trump renewed baseless allegations of voter fraud on Monday, questioning the legitimacy of last week’s midterm elections after Democrats swept both chambers of Congress in a crushing defeat for his Republican Party.
“Does anybody really believe that this ‘Election’ was honest. How could the Polls be so wrong???” Trump wrote on Truth Social, alleging without evidence that large early voting “dumps” had made Republican victories impossible.
“It’s all about the machines, which are far more important than the voter!” he added.
    
        
        
    
Chuck Schume

items.description:

items.title: Pakistani farmers in long fight to make German firms pay for 2022 flood damage
items.description:
In a village nestled in rice fields, Abdul Hafeez Khoso remembers the vast industrial zones he saw in Germany when he visited to file a pioneering climate legal case.
“They’re spreading pollution: up in the sky there are no borders, it can affect anywhere,” the 43-year-old said, describing areas far larger than his village of 800 people.
“This is a problem for the whole world — that is why it should be resolved at the global level.”

items.title: Water surges into nearby work areas after rock mass collapse at Tarbela Dam
items.description:
SWABI: A rock mass collapsed at the Tarbela Dam 5th Extension Project (T-5) construction site on Monday, causing a surge of water to enter nearby work areas, said the Water and Power Development Authority (Wapda).
An emergency was declared following the collapse; construction work was suspended and workers were directed to move to safer areas. However, no loss of life was reported in the incident.

items.description:
